column1: # Every house item a player may declare built, one row each, in the order the settings draw
# them, a fixed order that toggles and status never change. Each row gives the caption group
# it sits under, its label (short enough for two columns at sidebar width), the config key
# that holds the declaration, and the capability it is. Players' saved settings sit under
# Each group draws in two columns, left to right. Kharyrll sits fourth so the long portal
# names stay in the right-hand column and both columns fit the sidebar. The jewellery boxes
# run down the left and the mounts down the right.
